slot: Local entity and startup registrations (outside the US)

pick.name: Local limited company in your country (e.g. UK Ltd via Companies House)
pick.why: GBP 100 online, usually done within 24 hours; low-friction, investor-recognised

alts.name: India Private Limited + DPIIT recognition
alts.what: Pvt Ltd under Companies Act 2013, DPIIT startup status
alts.why: Needed for equity funding, ESOPs and 80-IAC tax holiday; sole prop and OPC not DPIIT-eligible
alts.free_limits: DPIIT recognition free; Pvt Ltd has incorporation, ROC filings and audit costs

alts.name: India sole proprietorship (PAN + Udyam + GST when needed)
alts.why: No registration fee or ROC filings; unlimited personal liability so cap liability by contract

candidates.name: Udyam + sole prop (India)
candidates.verdict: Free start in India; no DPIIT

candidates.name: India Pvt Ltd
candidates.verdict: Wins on funding, hiring, enterprise contracts

candidates.name: EU local company (GmbH/BV/SAS/OU)
candidates.verdict: Not researched here; costs and minimum capital vary by country (unverified)

candidates.name: India OPC / LLP
candidates.verdict: Weaker than Pvt Ltd for a funded product company

decision: Form the simplest local limited-liability company where you live and pay tax: a UK Ltd costs GBP 100 online and is usually registered within 24 hours; an Estonian OU via e-Residency suits EU-market founders who want a fully online EU company; India's Private Limited is the route for funding and DPIIT recognition. Switch to a Delaware C-corp (see entity slot) when US investors or US enterprise buyers require it.
details: No free option: every limited-liability company carries a government fee (UK GBP 100, Estonia EUR 265, Delaware USD 109); sole-trader/proprietor registration is free in many countries but gives no liability protection.

region_notes.UK: Ltd via Companies House costs GBP 100 online; annual confirmation statement and accounts required.
region_notes.EU: Each member state has its own company form, fees and capital rules; Estonia's e-Residency gives non-residents an online OU (EUR 265 state registration fee plus the e-Residency card fee, EUR 100-150, rising to a flat EUR 165 from 1 Jan 2027). Verify locally.
region_notes.India: A sole proprietorship needs no incorporation (PAN + Udyam, which is free, + GST when required); a Private Limited company is needed for equity funding, ESOPs and DPIIT recognition (DPIIT is free; sole props and OPCs are not eligible). Annual compliance costs vary; verify with a CA.
